responsibility: This header defines text_art::canvas, the central 2D cell grid abstraction for rendered text-art output. It declares the typed canvas geometry aliases, random-access painting and fill operations, and the pretty_printer emission API, while encapsulating storage as an array2 of styled_unichar cells tied to a style_manager for later styled output.
same_name_distinction: Defines and declares the canvas class, its geometry aliases, and public operations; unlike gcc/text-art/canvas.cc, it does not implement painting, row scanning, or pretty-printer emission.
